shortDescription: Emergent RimWorld harassment/bondage/control addon for RimJobWorld: abuse-gated conditioning with per-pawn susceptibility, a floating "Command deck" Harem window, weekly pet market, world-incident + notoriety layer (Karma integration), Tales, Ideology + Biotech integration, blackmail photos, a per-tick pawn-index + portrait-cache performance framework, and broad mod compat.
body:
# RimJobWorld - Sexual Harassment

C# addon for **RimJobWorld** (hard dep) + **Harmony**. Emergent harassment adapted from AAF Sexual Harassment (F4). Soft deps: SpeakUp, RimTalk, Karma & Reputation, c0ffee Animations, Melee Animation, [NL] Facial Animation, Onahole Extension, Rimpsyche, Modern Bio Tab, Simple Slavery Collars, BondageBed Torture, RJW Quirks/Sexperience/Genes. DLC-aware: Ideology + Biotech layers load only when active (LoadFolders IfModActive).

## Workflow rule (global)
Before ANY movement/rename/delete of source files, versioned timestamped backup to `D:\Rimworld\<About name>\<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>\`. D: = /d in git-bash. Global rules in `_dev\GLOBAL_RULES.md`. Key rules: **Frameworks Over Duplicated Code**, **Robust On Error** (try/catch every tick/entry point, kill-switch + fail-open). Finish work with 4 passovers + an honest 1-100% confidence score.

## AUDIT + REMEDIATION
Report: `Docs/QuadPass_Audit_2025.md` (+ .pdf, 12pp). Regenerate: `python Docs/_mkpdf.py <md> <html>` then Edge `--headless=new --print-to-pdf` (Windows paths + `file:///` URL).
Backups: `20260731-133346` (pre-A), `20260801-091824` (pre-C), `20260801-095351` (pre-D).

### TRANCHE A - DONE, tested (runs #235/#244)
- **C1** `SoftDeps.ModActive(packageId)` - ALL soft-dep probes route through it. Steam mods carry `ModMetaData.SteamModPostfix` = `"_steam"`, so 6 of 11 probes were silently false. **Never call `GetActiveModWithIdentifier` directly.**
- **U10** deleted the postfix on `Verse.Window.WindowOnGUI`; `Window_Harem` overrides `WindowOnGUI` (coords there are SCREEN space, post-`GUI.Window`).
- **T1** `Due(now, interval, phase)` + per-map `_mapPhase`. **GOTCHA:** the nested onahole `% 600` MUST also use `Due(now, 600, 0)` - it shares `_mapPhase` with followTick's 60; a raw `% 600` would never fire.
- **C2** `_tried` sentinels on the onahole type lookups. **T4** `RecomputeHeadGirls` scratch, cleared entry AND exit.

### TRANCHE B - DONE, tested
`Portraits` in `UI/ModernStyle.cs` is the ONLY caller of `PortraitsCache.Get`.
- **`Portraits.Sizer`** - 32px-snapped size while a rect moves, exact after 6 stable frames. Fixes the resize VRAM leak (PortraitsCache parks expired RenderTextures in a pool only emptied by `PortraitsCache.Clear()` on load/quit, so a resize-derived size stranded ~1.5 MB per pixel of drag).
- **`Portraits.PortraitBucket`** {32,48,64,96,128} via `size*0.9`; 8 RT families/pawn -> 3. All draws use `ScaleMode.ScaleToFit`.
- Repaint gating (portraits, border icons, stage corners). Zoom quantised 1/20 during transition only. Roster scroll culling.

### TRANCHE C - DONE, tested (isolated 13-mod run)
- **U8** `AllPets()` memoised per frame + `HashSet<int>` de-dupe (was `List.Contains`, O(n^2)). `FilterSortPets()` memoised per (frame, input signature), reusable buffers, `IndexOf(OrdinalIgnoreCase)` instead of 2 `ToLowerInvariant()` per pawn, 4 cached comparators. These ran 2-6x/frame; now once. **Sig only guards WITHIN a frame - across frames it always rebuilds, which is correct since pets/profiles change.**
- **U6** `ModernStyle.FillBar` - all 12 `FillableBar` sites converted to tinted `BaseContent.WhiteTex`; both per-colour texture caches deleted. **Deliberately NOT converted: `Gizmo_Conditioning.cs`** (its 4 textures are `static readonly`, created once - not the batching problem).
- **U11** `Patch_Pawn_GetGizmos` memoised per (thingIDNumber, frame). **U7** border-icon rects cached, rebuilt on resize.
- **F1 (partial)** `ModernStyle.GrayBtn`; the two byte-identical dialog copies forward to it. **`Window_Harem.GrayButton` deliberately NOT folded** - 0.89 vs 0.90 grey, 8px vs 6px truncate; folding would shift pixels. Documented in place.
- Still open: `DrawSummaryCard`'s O(n) loop runs once per pass (cheap, uncached).

### TRANCHE D1 - DONE (builds clean, 4 passovers). NOT YET TESTED.
- **T2** `MapComponent_HarassmentScan.Humanlikes()` / `Profiled()` + null-safe statics `HumanlikesOn(map)` / `ProfiledOn(map)`; every caller falls back to `?? map.mapPawns.AllPawnsSpawned` (fail-open). Routed: `RecomputeHeadGirls`, `HeadGirlTick`, `MemoryReactionScan` (-> profiled); `EvilKeyScavenge` Phase A, `PhotoScavenge`, `FireBystanderReactions` (-> humanlikes). Phase A and PhotoScavenge are nested inside ground-item loops, so those were O(items x every spawned thing).
  **Deliberately NOT routed: `EvilKeyScavenge` Phases B/C** - they gate on `holder.inventory != null` rather than Humanlike, and a player-owned animal can carry inventory (caravan packing); narrowing could silently drop a real case. Single pass, not nested. Commented in place.
  **Snapshots are READ-ONLY and must not be held across ticks** (all 7 sites are method-local).
- **C3** `FindLockedVictimForKey` memo re-keyed to `Dictionary<int,int>` (key thingId -> victim thingId, `-1` = memoised "none"), resolved via `PawnLookup.OnMap`. Was keyed on a live `CompHoloCryptoStamped` and stored a `Pawn`, which pinned the whole previous Game graph across a save->load; the 512 cap bounded entry count, not retained graph. `ClearKeyVictimCache()` called from `GameComponent.FinalizeInit`.
- **T3** `MemoryReactionScan` now rejects `kv.Value <= bestCount` BEFORE the `GenSight.LineOfSight` raycast, so LoS runs at most once per improvement instead of per in-range candidate. Result is identical (a candidate failing the sight check never updates bestCount). The per-pass work cap from the audit was **not** needed after this and is dropped.

### REMAINING
- **F2 TickScheduler - RECOMMEND SKIPPING.** Its value was centralising 9 inline moduli, which Tranche A's `Due(now, interval, phase)` already delivered (uniform, visible in one place, phase-assignable). A scheduler object would add indirection for no measurable gain.
- **T5 profile pruning - NEEDS EXPLICIT APPROVAL (data risk).** `GameComponent.profiles` has no pruning path, grows monotonically, is deep-Scribed into every save, and `sex?.HourlyDrift()` runs for every profile forever. Proposed predicate: drop only when the pawn resolves to null via `PawnLookup.AnyMap` AND is absent from `Find.WorldPawns` AND has no nemesis record AND no live owner link. Dropping a world-pawn's profile would erase nemesis grudges, so the predicate matters more than the sweep.
- **F3** partial-class split of the 6577-line `HarassmentEngine.cs` (maintainability only). Overlaps the dead-layout decision.
- **D3 integrations:** risk pair FIRST - `Mlie.Suppression` (overlaps `SlaveryHooks.SyncSuppression`; possible double-suppression) and `Mlie.PrisonersDontHaveKeys` (overlaps Holokey inventory logic). Then Vanilla Skills Expanded ExpertiseDefs (Phase E flagship, confirmed installed), Nudity Matters More, Privacy Please, RimHUD, Grudges!, Rimpsyche-Disposition, Restraints/SimpleRestraintBelt, Epitaph/In Memoriam, VSIE, MorePrecepts/AlphaMemes. Melee Animation is claimed as a soft dep but has NO implementing code.

### DEAD UI LAYOUT - AWAITING DECISION (untouched)
Six top-level draw methods in `Window_Harem.cs` have **zero call sites** (pre-"Concept 3" layout): `DrawHarem`, `DrawPetList`, `DrawDetailPanel`, `DrawRoster`, `DrawColonyPanel`, `DrawViewToggle`, plus exclusive helpers. `_view` / `ViewNames` are vestiges. **The Harem-table culling added in Tranche B sits in dead code** (the LIVE culling win is the roster column). A reachability script claimed ~975 dead lines but has false positives - it misses calls from property bodies (`EnsureFontH`, `DrawGlance` x21, `DrawSchedule` x3 are live). **Do not bulk-delete on the script's word.**

### FACIAL ANIMATION REGRESSION - FIXED
Mouths flapped open/shut. **Cause was a def, not the bridge.** `RJWSH_FA_Afraid` (PERSISTENT, thought-gated) claimed `mouthShapeDef`; `AnimationFrameAccumulator` resolves each channel as **last non-null writer wins, recomputed every tick**, so it fought FA's always-on `Constant` animation (breathing) and the winner alternated. `RJWSH_FA_Hollow` had the same bug on `lidShapeDef` vs the blink cycle (unreported).
**CHANNEL RULE:** a persistent thought-gated FaceAnimationDef may claim ONLY `headShapeDef` + `browShapeDef`. Mouth/lid belong to `Constant.xml` and `ForJobs/*.xml`; FA's own `Thoughts.xml` obeys this. Palette = head (normal|blush) x brow (angled|flat|normal|s-shaped). One-shots are exempt (they go to `forcedTemporaryAnimationList`, drained by `RemoveAll(IsFinished)`, so a finite `<duration>` retires them).
Faces: Nervous blush+s-shaped, Afraid blush+angled, Hollow normal+flat, Devoted blush+normal.
**FABridge exonerated + re-enabled** (documented `Enabled` kill switch, `static readonly` not `const` to avoid CS0162). `PlayTemporaryAnimation(Pawn, int startTick, params string[])` takes a **start tick, not a duration**.

### OTHER MODS - findings from test runs (for their own sessions)
- **Rimpsyche:** native crash (`__icall_wrapper_ves_icall_object_new_specific`) inside `Harmony.PatchAll` from its `.cctor`, under a 909-mod load. Allocation failure during IL reading; not reproducible in the 13-mod isolated list.
- **Modern CC:** a saved pawn ("Kara 'Mercer' Mercer") deserialises against missing defs (`GAT_Ares`, `MSSRPG_Backstory_CircleOfTheStars`, `Cisgender`, `NarrowShoulders`) -> 11 cascading errors ending in `SaveableFromNode` NREs and null needs. Null-check def resolution when loading presets.
- **Itemization Overhaul - Core:** `Failed to get last layer on apparel item` - `.Last()` on `apparel.layers`, empty for malformed third-party defs (`Apparel_PAHMechaBunnyEars`). Needs a `NullOrEmpty` guard.
- **Wayfarers / Psycasts:** `Could not find player faction` from two distinct call paths - reads `Faction.OfPlayer` before it exists (move to `FinalizeInit`).

## Testing
Default to **isolated** with targeted companions - 13 mods loads in seconds and avoids other mods' startup fragility. Use non-isolated only when validating soft-dep detection against the real install. Confirmed companion set: `astryl.Circinus`, `astryl.ModernDevTools`, `astryl.ModernNotifications` (+ **`Nals.FacialAnimation` going forward**, per user).

## Performance framework
- **PawnIndex.cs** per-tick index (`_byId` + `_humanlikes` + `_profiled`); `PawnById(id)` O(1); `Humanlikes()`/`Profiled()` snapshots.
- **PawnLookup** `OnMap`/`AnyMap`. **PawnFlagCache** tick-scoped collar/onahole memo, keyed on ids.
- **Tick phasing** `Due(now, interval, phase)` + `_mapPhase`.
- **UI** `Portraits` (single `PortraitsCache.Get` gate), `FillBar`, `GrayBtn`; per-frame roster + gizmo caches.

## Feature reference
**Target selection:** `TryRunOnMap` weighted-picks a harasser (HarasserWillingness), `FindTarget` builds the victim pool. **Sex/orientation gate = `IsAttracted(harasser,target)` (public);** `JobDriver_Harass` re-checks during the walk (FailOn) and at arrival; player-directed grope/force bypasses it.
**Interactive training** (`Window_TrainingSession.cs`, `interactiveTraining` ON): Discipline opens a 3-round read-the-pet minigame (hidden Defiant/Fearful/Yearning leaked by a tell; Firm/Gentle/Degrade).
**Ideology rituals:** collaring ceremony + devotion parade, gated to the **RJWSH_Ownership meme**. PLAYER-initiated, ROLE-LESS gather-party, outcome worker subclasses RitualOutcomeEffectWorker_FromQuality. **UNTESTED IN-GAME - highest-risk surface.**
**Tales/Chronicle/Legacy:** 6 TaleDefs; `PawnProfile.chronicle` (cap 100) + History tab; Harmony Postfix on `Pawn.Kill` -> OnOwnerDied; nemesis escapees return as raid leaders; blackmail photo -> faction demand. Shared `SpawnAssaultRaid`/`PickRaidFaction`.
**Notoriety x Karma:** `AddNotoriety(amt, reason)` = local 0-100 meter + mirror -amt*3 colony infamy; world-incident pacing scales with regard. No-ops without Karma.
**Harem window:** floating Modern Suite deck - left roster, centre STAGE / MARKET PODIUM, right OPS + COLONY OPS, bulk bar. Owns its resize grip. Tailor/Stylist/Photos drawn INLINE (`_opsMode`).
**Market/Conditioning:** weekly market; collar SEVERITY grants Masochist/Stockholm (abuse-gated + susceptibility); BreakStage {Defiant,Wavering,Compliant,Devoted,Broken}; escape/sale/rescue -> RegisterNemesis.
**Settings:** masterEnabled, enableSounds, interactiveTraining, showControlTab, showSexualityTab (OFF), hideKeyHolderGizmos, enableFleeBeating/BeatToDeath, conditioningInstallsQuirks/Gene, Performance: enableDepthSystems, enableAmbientBanter, ambientBanterScale, affectionInterval, begInterval.
**Roadmap:** A-D done. **E (next):** #10 Devoted endgame roles as VSE ExpertiseDefs + #9 Hospitality integration.

## Conventions
Vanilla sentence case, ASCII hyphen only. Event.current not Input. **UI = Modern Suite.** Harmony PatchAll (astryl.RJWSexualHarassment). Rituals: player-started + role-less + FromQuality subclass ONLY. **Attraction gate = `IsAttracted`.** **id->Pawn via PawnLookup/PawnById; hot predicates via PawnFlagCache; periodic scans via `Humanlikes()`/`Profiled()`; never re-add a linear AllPawnsSpawned scan for an id lookup.** **Soft-dep probes go through `SoftDeps.ModActive`.** **Periodic work goes through `Due(now, interval, phase)` - never a bare `now % N`.** **ALL portraits go through `Portraits.Head`/`Body`; never hand `PortraitsCache.Get` an unquantised resize-derived size.** **Bars go through `ModernStyle.FillBar`.** **Persistent FA faces: head+brow only.** **Never Harmony-patch a global UI method for our own chrome.** **Static caches key on thingIDNumber, never a Thing/Comp/Pawn reference; memoise the negative result; clear on FinalizeInit.**
